headline: Renewable Energy Stocks Rally After US Congressional Election Results
summary: Renewable energy stocks rallied in Asia and Europe following the United States mid-term elections, which resulted in Democrats taking control of both the House and Senate.
why: Political shifts in major economies heavily influence fiscal policy, subsidies, and regulatory frameworks governing the energy sector, directly impacting clean tech valuations.

impacts.name: Clean Energy Sector
impacts.why: Expectation of favorable federal policies and legislative support following the congressional shift.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors bid up renewable energy equities on expectations that a Democratic-controlled U.S. Congress will advance favorable clean energy legislation and increased federal spending.
